meta.title: Duo Model Routing
meta.description: Pick a planner model and a worker model in two cells: the planner thinks and decides, the worker executes — better results at a lower cost.

title: Duo
plannerHint: Understands the request, decomposes the task, decides
workerHint: Delegated by the planner, does the actual work
savedHint: Allowlist written: {planner} plans, {worker} executes. Takes effect in new sessions.
enterHint: Enter picks the first match · Ctrl+Enter keeps thinking here
plannerFollow: Planner follows this session model ({name}): switched, effective on the next turn.
